errors.text: The proposed Cr addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
No definite alloy composition, Cr concentration, processing temperature, exposure time, oxidation temperature, or corrosion environment is specified.
Neither cited study concerns a Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloy; E1 is a refractory WVTaTiCr coating and E2 is an Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloy.
The claimed formation of a stable coherent precipitate is not supported by the cited evidence; E1 instead reports increasing Laves-phase precipitation, while E2 reports B2/BCC decomposition.
The hypothesis supplies no quantitative predictions for density, hardness, compression, corrosion electrochemistry, or oxidation kinetics.
The experiment omits a defined composition-matched control, oxidation protocol, exposure duration, electrochemical environment, and quantitative decision thresholds.
